root: ^Balbino: You’ve beaten me… a lifetime of training, and still you struck me down—easily, and before my kin.
^ Truly, there is no greater shame. Cursed by my half-blood… neither orc nor elf… nowhere I belong,
^Cacildes: You fought well… but not with the savagery of the other orcs.
^ Perhaps the crushing instinct just isn’t in you. It seems you want it, though. You’re a strange one.
^Balbino: You think you know me from a single clash… I’ve endured trials you couldn’t imagine.
^ There is still chaos in me… and I burn for it… The Cold Fire Stone… hidden in Arun Village...
^Balbino: I must carry my legacy—whatever you might wish for me.
^Drogo: Another disappointment from the half-breed… but it matters little.
^Drogo: He has played his part. And so will you, child. I have seen the Cold Fire Stone shattered in my visions.
^Drogo: And my visions do not lie. You *will* play your role, whether you wish it or not.
^Fade, Hide The Orcs And Free Captain Pleias
^Captain Pleias: Phew… thank you for freeing me. I was starting to fear my end had come.
^Captain Pleias: The orcs are gone… You’ll be rewarded for this, no doubt. As for me… the king won’t be pleased
^ with my reckless expedition. But that’s my burden.
^Captain Pleias: I’m heading back to the village. I’ll throw a grand feast for you at the tavern.
^ Don’t be long — pick clean whatever spoils you’ve missed here, then get the hell out… this place has long
